Name: Bara Anthro Character Supplement
Author: Sparkplus
Description:
When I use BaraAnthroCharacters and Enti's Furry Barafications, I enjoy being overwhelmed by handsome bara characters. However, some characters lack bara portraits and winter portraits, then I found excellent art created by some authors. In order to toggle the portraits and sprites easily,  I coded this mod.

This mod [b]supplements the missing Bara portraits and winter portraits[/b] of characters. The portraits I used in this mod were created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/KagamiSora03?gameId=1303]KagamiSora03[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/XT2048?gameId=1303]XT2048[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/TomFoxx93?gameId=1303]TomFoxx93[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Entifrisky/mods?gameId=1303]Entifrisky[/url], [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Draevahn]Draevahn[/url]. I am using some excellent sprites created by XT2048, TomFoxx93 and Draevahn. Therefore, this mod can also [b]toggle sprites[/b] created by them.

This mod should be used along with BaraAnthroCharacters and Enti's Furry Barafications. When you want to toggle portraits or sprites of certain characters, the three mods shoud be set up at the same time. This mod has higher priority and overrites characters after them and AnthroCharactersContinueed.

So far all the assets have been added to this mod. Thanks for the permissions!
